page_title: MNT 1-2 LYO | Montpellier v Lyon 11/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.

90+5' Leo Leroy (Montpellier) reacts well and displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross from the free kick. He jumps high and produces a header which goes well wide of the left post.
90+5' A player from Lyon takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Montpellier have a free kick.
90+2' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) takes a mid-range free kick, but his miskick only goes into the stands. Poor shot!
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The yellow card is received by Gift Orban (Lyon).
90' Jordan Ferri (Montpellier) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Pierre Gaillouste didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
89' Substitution. Leo Leroy (Montpellier) has come on for Modibo Sagnan.
89' Michel Der Zakarian has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) replacing Teji Savanier.
89' Substitution. Gift Orban (Lyon) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Alexandre Lacazette walks off.
87' Issiaga Sylla (Montpellier) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
82' 1 - 2 Maxence Caqueret (Lyon) unleashes a bullet of a strike from the edge of the penalty box and the ball ricochets into the goal off the crossbar!
82' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
81' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Rayan Cherki (Lyon) inside the box. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Lyon.
78' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) takes a short corner kick.
74' 1 - 1 GOAL! Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) finds the back of the net from close in from a very acute angle.
73' A lofted cross from Issiaga Sylla (Montpellier) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
69' Kiki Kouyate (Montpellier) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header is so wild it sails way past the right post and behind for a goal kick.
67' Silvan Hefti (Montpellier) just cannot continue due to injury and has to be substituted. Enzo Tchato replaces him.
64' It is time for a substitution. Yann Karamoh (Montpellier) is on for Arnaud Nordin.
63' Arnaud Nordin (Montpellier) commits a rough foul. Pierre Gaillouste stops the game and makes a call.
60' The ball falls kindly for Kiki Kouyate (Montpellier) inside the box, but it's a poor effort and flies high over the bar.
60' Montpellier fail to score from a corner as Anthony Lopes (Lyon) leaps to collect the ball.
59' Arnaud Nordin (Montpellier) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. The referee blows his whistle, Montpellier are awarded a corner kick.
57' The referee signals a substitution. Rayan Cherki (Lyon) is brought on as a substitute for Said Benrahma.
57' Pierre Sage has decided to substitute Ainsley Maitland-Niles and he is replaced by Clinton Mata (Lyon).
57' That's the end of the game for Ernest Nuamah, who is replaced by Malick Fofana (Lyon).

54' Unbelievable! Akor Adams (Montpellier) wastes a huge scoring opportunity! He finds himself unmarked right in front of goal and fires in a first-time shot. Anthony Lopes pulls off one of the best saves of his career and stops the effort from hitting the net.
53' Said Benrahma (Lyon) finds himself unmarked on the edge of the box, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post.
52' Jordan Ferri (Montpellier) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
49' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) volleys the ball on the edge of the box after a rebound. It's a great effort and has Anthony Lopes scrambling, but it flies just wide of the left post.
48' Maxence Caqueret (Lyon) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
47' Arnaud Nordin (Montpellier) tackles a bit over-zealously and Pierre Gaillouste blows for a foul.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' Close! Said Benrahma (Lyon) takes the resulting free kick from a promising positon, but his effort flies inches wide of the right post.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
44' Pierre Sage is forced to make a change. Corentin Tolisso is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Orel Mangala (Lyon).
41' Silvan Hefti (Montpellier) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.

40' Becir Omeragic (Montpellier) leaps highest around the penalty spot to meet a cross from the free kick and produces a promising goal-bound header towards the middle of the goal, but Anthony Lopes pulls off a comfortable save to deny him.
40' A player from Lyon commits a rough challenge. Pierre Gaillouste blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. It's a free kick to Montpellier in a dangerous position.
38' Lyon take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
38' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. Lyon have a corner.
38' Issiaga Sylla (Montpellier) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
36' The goalkeeper pulls off a save to deny Ernest Nuamah (Lyon), whose effort is only aimed at the middle of the goal.
34' Said Benrahma (Lyon) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
34' Silvan Hefti (Montpellier) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
32' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) had a golden opportunity. He volleyed from point blank range towards the middle of the goal, but Benjamin Lecomte was alert and made an amazing save!
31' Kiki Kouyate (Montpellier) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
29' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Montpellier, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
28' Pierre Gaillouste shows a yellow card to Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) for his blatant foul.
27' The cross into the penalty area from Silvan Hefti (Montpellier) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.

23' 1 - 0 Issiaga Sylla showcases his great technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box. Arnaud Nordin (Montpellier) meets the cross and gets himself onto the scoresheet with a header inside the right post. It's 1:0.
19' The corner is aimed towards the penalty spot where it's met by Corentin Tolisso (Lyon), but his timing is poor and it flies high over the bar.
19' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Lyon.
18' The shots on goal statistics – 0:0.
17' A goal, which was scored by Akor Adams (Montpellier), was disallowed due to offside.
13' The corner is swung in but Lyon can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

12' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) tries to latch onto a defence-splitting pass, but one of the defending players intercepts the effort and the danger passes. The ball is out of play. Lyon will have a chance to score from a corner.
10' Pierre Gaillouste blows his whistle after Maxence Caqueret (Lyon) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
9' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Said Benrahma (Lyon).
6' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) has a go from distance but he can't find the target as it goes well wide of the left post.
4' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Lyon will have the kick-off.
Pierre Gaillouste is introduced as the referee for today's match.
